title: Envelopes from TrackInfo and BusInfo automation lanes, resolved to controls (automation.rs)
description:
## Intent

Envelopes pointing at mixer controls and device parameters.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/automation.rs`: for each `Lane` in `TrackInfo.automation` and `BusInfo.automation` (`crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs`), resolve the target to a control: mixer volume/pan/send, or the n-th device of its kind's parameter (the ids of the device templates from M3); write the envelope with its breakpoints, per the format in `design/daw-set.md`.
- Step lanes: each value held, a jump at the next point (two breakpoints at one beat). Before the first point and after the last: held.
- On a track spread over several audio tracks, lanes go on its group.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Automation lands on the right control" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): automation envelopes in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
